description:
After today, Claude Fable 5 is pay-per-use, out of reach for 99% of people. So today, train the cheaper models to act like Fable 5.

Three moves before it goes paid:

1. Get Fable to review all your CLAUDE.mds, so cheaper models inherit its best practices.
2. Get it to audit your skills, kill the redundant ones and build new ones.
3. Get it to write your PRDs and roadmaps, then hand the plan to a cheaper model to run.

Because the top 1% of results don't come from the best model. They come from the harness you build instead.

Comment HARNESS and I'll send you the three exact prompts.
